text:
## Policy Statement  
**FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously and resolves them fairly within regulatory timeframes.**

raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's formal policy governing the fair and timely resolution of customer complaints in accordance with regulatory requirements. The policy establishes the bank's commitment to treating all complaints seriously and resolving them within mandated regulatory timeframes.
context: FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously and resolves them fairly within regulatory timeframes.

raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that FirstUK Bank must resolve all customer complaints fairly and within regulatory timeframes. This provision establishes the operational standard for complaint handling across the bank.
